body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one adjacent willing ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 and its next forced movement by 1 unit until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit toward you.
Protect yourself and one adjacent willing ally instead.

rider.title: Combo - Guard
rider.html: Spend 1 Combo to enter Tortoise Stance: while adjacent to the protected ally, you may take the first 1 Damage that would hit it before your next turn instead.
